Now I have a thorough picture of the repository's validation mechanisms. Let me compile the findings.

---

## Code-Review and Validation Mechanisms at `45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f`

---

### 1. Continuous Integration — Azure Pipelines

**Source:** [`.azure-pipelines/azure-pipelines.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.azure-pipelines/azure-pipelines.yml)

The pipeline is **repository-wide**. It triggers on all PRs and pushes to `devel` and `stable-*` branches (`autoCancel: true` on PRs), and runs nightly (`cron: 0 7 * * *`).

**Stages declared (all run in parallel — `dependsOn: []`):**

| Stage | Scope |
|---|---|
| `Sanity` | 5 parallel shards (`sanity/1` through `sanity/5`) |
| `Units` | Python 2.7, 3.5–3.11 |
| `Windows` | Server 2012, 2012-R2, 2016, 2019, 2022 |
| `Remote` | macOS 12.0, RHEL 7.9/8.6/9.0, FreeBSD 12.3/13.1 — multiple groups |
| `Docker` | Alpine 3, CentOS 7, Fedora 36, openSUSE 15, Ubuntu 20.04/22.04 |
| `Galaxy` | Python 3.9, 3.10, 3.11 |
| `Generic` | Python 3.9, 3.10, 3.11 |
| `Incidental_Windows` | Same Windows matrix |
| `Incidental` | IOS, VyOS |
| `Summary` | Runs `succeededOrFailed()`, aggregates coverage |

Each job is dispatched through [`.azure-pipelines/templates/matrix.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.azure-pipelines/templates/matrix.yml) → [`.azure-pipelines/templates/test.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.azure-pipelines/templates/test.yml), which calls [`run-tests.sh`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.azure-pipelines/scripts/run-tests.sh) → `test/utils/shippable/shippable.sh` (entry point), then [`process-results.sh`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.azure-pipelines/scripts/process-results.sh) which exports `haveTestResults`, `haveBotResults`, and `haveCoverageData` variables. JUnit XML results are published via `PublishTestResults@2`; bot results and coverage data are published as pipeline artifacts.

**Coverage** is collected only on scheduled (nightly) builds on branches listed in `coverageBranches` (currently `devel`), controlled by the `COVERAGE` environment variable set in [`run-tests.sh`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.azure-pipelines/scripts/run-tests.sh?L26-L32).

The test container image is pinned: `quay.io/ansible/azure-pipelines-test-container:3.0.0`.

---

### 2. Sanity Checks (`ansible-test sanity`)

**Source:** [`test/sanity/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/tree/test/sanity)

These are **repository-wide** automated checks run as the `Sanity` stage. Two mechanisms:

#### 2a. Custom Code-Smell Plugins

All live in [`test/sanity/code-smell/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/tree/test/sanity/code-smell). Each has a `.json` descriptor controlling which file prefixes it applies to, and a `.py` script that performs the check. **Catalog:**

| Check | What it enforces |
|---|---|
| [`botmeta.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/botmeta.py) | `.github/BOTMETA.yml` is valid YAML, schema-validates with `voluptuous`, and that `.github/BOTMETA.yml` itself carries `support: core` |
| [`required-and-default-attributes.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/required-and-default-attributes.py) | No `FieldAttribute` uses both `required` and `default` simultaneously |
| [`no-unwanted-files.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/no-unwanted-files.py) | All `lib/` content is under `lib/ansible/`; only `.cs`, `.ps1`, `.psm1`, `.py` (plus `.yml` in test/filter plugins) allowed |
| [`obsolete-files.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/obsolete-files.py) | Rejects any file under now-obsolete directories (old `test/sanity/ansible-doc/`, `test/sanity/pep8/`, `test/sanity/pylint/`, etc., as listed in [`obsolete-files.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/obsolete-files.json)) |
| [`package-data.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/package-data.py) | Builds and installs the actual sdist via `make snapshot`, then cross-checks that shipped/installed file sets match the repository's expectation |
| [`update-bundled.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/update-bundled.py) | Queries PyPI for the current version of each bundled library (`six`, `distro`, `selectors2`, `urls.py`) and fails if the bundle is behind the latest compatible release. **Disabled by default** (listed in [`skip.txt`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/skip.txt)) |
| [`deprecated-config.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/deprecated-config.py) | Scans plugin DOCUMENTATION blocks and `lib/ansible/config/base.yml` for `deprecated:` entries whose removal version is ≤ current ansible-core major. **Disabled by default** (in `skip.txt`) |
| [`ansible-test-future-boilerplate.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/ansible-test-future-boilerplate.py) | Requires `from __future__ import annotations` in all non-Python-2-compat files; rejects older `__metaclass__ = type` forms |
| [`release-names.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/release-names.py) | Verifies `ansible.release.__codename__` is listed in [`.github/RELEASE_NAMES.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.github/RELEASE_NAMES.yml) |
| [`configure-remoting-ps1.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/configure-remoting-ps1.py) | Enforces that `test/lib/ansible_test/_util/target/setup/ConfigureRemotingForAnsible.ps1` is a byte-for-byte copy of `examples/scripts/ConfigureRemotingForAnsible.ps1` and that neither is a symlink |
| [`docs-build.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/docs-build.py) | Runs `make core_singlehtmldocs` and fails on non-zero exit; also captures Sphinx warnings from `docs/docsite/rst_warnings` and classifies/surfaces them |
| [`rstcheck.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/rstcheck.py) | RST syntax checking |
| [`test-constraints.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/test-constraints.py) | Validates test constraint files |
| [`ansible-requirements.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/ansible-requirements.py) | Validates Ansible requirements files |

**Disabled-by-default checks** (declared in [`test/sanity/code-smell/skip.txt`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/code-smell/skip.txt)):
- `deprecated-config.py` — enabled by the release manager after branching
- `update-bundled.py` — enabled by the release manager after branching

#### 2b. Sanity Ignore File

[`test/sanity/ignore.txt`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/ignore.txt) suppresses specific known-failing checks on a per-file, per-rule basis. Examples of rule types suppressed: `validate-modules:parameter-invalid`, `validate-modules:doc-default-does-not-match-spec`, `pylint:disallowed-name`, `pslint:PSCustomUseLiteralPath`, `use-argspec-type-path`, `import-*!skip`, `future-import-boilerplate`, `no-assert`. Many entries carry inline `# comments` explaining the rationale. The file itself is owned in BOTMETA (`test/sanity/ignore.txt: notified: tremble`), meaning a specific maintainer is notified of changes.

The file represents accumulated technical debt; each entry is a suppression that requires explicit addition and (by convention) justification.

---

### 3. Ownership Rules — BOTMETA

**Source:** [`.github/BOTMETA.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.github/BOTMETA.yml)

Repository-wide. Consumed by an ansibot/botmeta automation layer (not present in this repo). Key structural properties:

- **`automerge: false`** — no PR is auto-merged.
- **`collection_redirect: true`** — directs some issues to collection repos.
- **`notifications: false`** — bot-driven notifications disabled.
- **`macros`** section defines reusable team aliases: `team_networking` (8 members), `team_windows_core` (`nitzmahone`, `jborean93`), `team_ansible` (empty list — all core).
- **`files`** section maps path prefixes to per-path metadata: `maintainers`, `notified`, `ignored`, `labels`, `support`, `keywords`, `supershipit`.
- Notified parties for infrastructure-sensitive paths: `mattclay` for `test/lib/`, `test/sanity/`, `test/utils/shippable/`, `hacking/shippable/`, `hacking/report.py`, `lib/ansible/utils/collection_loader.py`, `lib/ansible/release.py`; `nitzmahone` for `lib/ansible/release.py`; `gundalow` for docs paths and `lib/ansible/config/ansible_builtin_runtime.yml`; `tremble` for `test/sanity/ignore.txt`.
- Validated at CI time by `test/sanity/code-smell/botmeta.py` (schema check) and `test/sanity/code-smell/botmeta.json` (scope: only `.github/BOTMETA.yml` itself).

---

### 4. PR Template

**Source:** [`.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md)

Repository-wide, structural (not enforced mechanically). Requires:
- **SUMMARY** — rationale, design decisions; hint to include `Fixes #nnn`
- **ISSUE TYPE** — one of: Bugfix / Docs / Feature / Test Pull Request
- **COMPONENT NAME**
- **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** — reproduction steps / before-after output

There is no automated check that the template fields are filled in.

---

### 5. Changelog Fragments

**Source:** [`changelogs/config.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/changelogs/config.yaml), [`changelogs/fragments/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/tree/changelogs/fragments)

Repository-wide antsibull-changelog convention. Fragments present at this revision fall into sections: `major_changes`, `minor_changes`, `breaking_changes`, `deprecated_features`, `removed_features`, `security_fixes`, `bugfixes`, `known_issues`. Configuration: `keep_fragments: true`, `always_refresh: true`, `ignore_other_fragment_extensions: true`. Fragments at this revision include entries keyed by issue/PR number (e.g., `71424-deterministic-vault-encode.yml`, `79546-apt-fix-setting-locale.yml`). The `package-data.py` check excludes `changelogs/fragments/*` from the sdist (dev-only artefacts).

---

### 6. Backport and Cherry-Pick Infrastructure

**Sources:** [`hacking/backport/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/tree/hacking/backport), [`.cherry_picker.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.cherry_picker.toml)

- **`.cherry_picker.toml`**: configures the `cherry_picker` tool (`team=ansible`, `repo=ansible`, `default_branch=devel`, `fix_commit_msg=false`). `check_sha` is set to `f31421576b00f0b167cdbe61217c31c21a41ac02` (first repo commit).
- **`hacking/backport/backport_of_line_adder.py`**: a `PyGithub`-based script that adds a `"Backport of ..."` reference line to new backport PRs, with an `auto` mode that deduces the original PR from context. Prompts before making changes.

---

### 7. Blame-Ignore Revs

**Source:** [`.git-blame-ignore-revs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.git-blame-ignore-revs)

One entry: commit `6def4a3180fe03981ba64c6d8db28fed3bb39c0c`, labelled `Bulk PowerShell sanity fixes`. This indicates a historical bulk-format or bulk-lint commit that was excluded from `git blame` to preserve meaningful authorship for surrounding lines.

### 8. Test Infrastructure Shape

**Source:** [`test/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/tree/test)

- **`test/units/`** — Python unit tests organized by subsystem (`cli/`, `executor/`, `galaxy/`, `inventory/`, `module_utils/`, `modules/`, `parsing/`, `playbook/`, `plugins/`, `template/`, `utils/`, `vars/`). Includes `test/units/requirements.txt`.
- **`test/integration/`** — integration targets for CI.
- **`test/lib/`** — `ansible-test` library (`ansible_test/`), notified to `mattclay` in BOTMETA.
- **`test/ansible_test/`** — ansible-test self-tests.
- **`test/support/`** — support files (excluded from sdist per `package-data.py`).

### Summary: Repository-Wide vs. Change-Specific

| Mechanism | Scope |
|---|---|
| Azure Pipelines stages (Sanity, Units, Windows, Remote, Docker, Galaxy, Generic, Incidental) | **Repository-wide** — applies to every PR and push |
| BOTMETA ownership/notification rules | **Repository-wide** |
| All `test/sanity/code-smell/` checks | **Repository-wide** |
| `test/sanity/ignore.txt` suppressions | **Repository-wide** (each line is per-file, per-rule) |
| `.cherry_picker.toml` / backport tooling | **Repository-wide** |
| `.git-blame-ignore-revs` entry for `6def4a3` | **Tied to a specific historical bulk-fix commit** |
| `changelogs/fragments/` at this revision | **Tied to specific changes** (each fragment = one PR/fix) |
| `skip.txt` disabling `deprecated-config` and `update-bundled` | **Release-phase-specific** (enabled post-branching by release manager) |

#### 2b. Sanity Ignore File

[`test/sanity/ignore.txt`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/test/sanity/ignore.txt) suppresses specific known-failing checks on a per-file, per-rule basis. Examples of rule types suppressed: `validate-modules:parameter-invalid`, `validate-modules:doc-default-does-not-match-spec`, `pylint:disallowed-name`, `pslint:PSCustomUseLiteralPath`, `use-argspec-type-path`, `import-*!skip`, `future-import-boilerplate`, `no-assert`. Many entries carry inline `# comments` explaining the rationale. The file itself is owned in BOTMETA (`test/sanity/ignore.txt: notified: tremble`), meaning a specific maintainer is notified of changes.

The file represents accumulated technical debt; each entry is a suppression that requires explicit addition and (by convention) justification.

### 3. Ownership Rules — BOTMETA

**Source:** [`.github/BOTMETA.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.github/BOTMETA.yml)

Repository-wide. Consumed by an ansibot/botmeta automation layer (not present in this repo). Key structural properties:

- **`automerge: false`** — no PR is auto-merged.
- **`collection_redirect: true`** — directs some issues to collection repos.
- **`notifications: false`** — bot-driven notifications disabled.
- **`macros`** section defines reusable team aliases: `team_networking` (8 members), `team_windows_core` (`nitzmahone`, `jborean93`), `team_ansible` (empty list — all core).
- **`files`** section maps path prefixes to per-path metadata: `maintainers`, `notified`, `ignored`, `labels`, `support`, `keywords`, `supershipit`.
- Notified parties for infrastructure-sensitive paths: `mattclay` for `test/lib/`, `test/sanity/`, `test/utils/shippable/`, `hacking/shippable/`, `hacking/report.py`, `lib/ansible/utils/collection_loader.py`, `lib/ansible/release.py`; `nitzmahone` for `lib/ansible/release.py`; `gundalow` for docs paths and `lib/ansible/config/ansible_builtin_runtime.yml`; `tremble` for `test/sanity/ignore.txt`.
- Validated at CI time by `test/sanity/code-smell/botmeta.py` (schema check) and `test/sanity/code-smell/botmeta.json` (scope: only `.github/BOTMETA.yml` itself).

---

### 4. PR Template

**Source:** [`.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md)

Repository-wide, structural (not enforced mechanically). Requires:
- **SUMMARY** — rationale, design decisions; hint to include `Fixes #nnn`
- **ISSUE TYPE** — one of: Bugfix / Docs / Feature / Test Pull Request
- **COMPONENT NAME**
- **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** — reproduction steps / before-after output

There is no automated check that the template fields are filled in.

### 5. Changelog Fragments

**Source:** [`changelogs/config.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/changelogs/config.yaml), [`changelogs/fragments/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/tree/changelogs/fragments)

Repository-wide antsibull-changelog convention. Fragments present at this revision fall into sections: `major_changes`, `minor_changes`, `breaking_changes`, `deprecated_features`, `removed_features`, `security_fixes`, `bugfixes`, `known_issues`. Configuration: `keep_fragments: true`, `always_refresh: true`, `ignore_other_fragment_extensions: true`. Fragments at this revision include entries keyed by issue/PR number (e.g., `71424-deterministic-vault-encode.yml`, `79546-apt-fix-setting-locale.yml`). The `package-data.py` check excludes `changelogs/fragments/*` from the sdist (dev-only artefacts).

### 6. Backport and Cherry-Pick Infrastructure

**Sources:** [`hacking/backport/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/tree/hacking/backport), [`.cherry_picker.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.cherry_picker.toml)

- **`.cherry_picker.toml`**: configures the `cherry_picker` tool (`team=ansible`, `repo=ansible`, `default_branch=devel`, `fix_commit_msg=false`). `check_sha` is set to `f31421576b00f0b167cdbe61217c31c21a41ac02` (first repo commit).
- **`hacking/backport/backport_of_line_adder.py`**: a `PyGithub`-based script that adds a `"Backport of ..."` reference line to new backport PRs, with an `auto` mode that deduces the original PR from context. Prompts before making changes.

**Source:** [`.git-blame-ignore-revs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible@45df14a2e05573e6213ce789aa3278f4f30fa54f/-/blob/.git-blame-ignore-revs)

### Summary: Repository-Wide vs. Change-Specific

| Mechanism | Scope |
|---|---|
| Azure Pipelines stages (Sanity, Units, Windows, Remote, Docker, Galaxy, Generic, Incidental) | **Repository-wide** — applies to every PR and push |
| BOTMETA ownership/notification rules | **Repository-wide** |
| All `test/sanity/code-smell/` checks | **Repository-wide** |
| `test/sanity/ignore.txt` suppressions | **Repository-wide** (each line is per-file, per-rule) |
| `.cherry_picker.toml` / backport tooling | **Repository-wide** |
| `.git-blame-ignore-revs` entry for `6def4a3` | **Tied to a specific historical bulk-fix commit** |
| `changelogs/fragments/` at this revision | **Tied to specific changes** (each fragment = one PR/fix) |
| `skip.txt` disabling `deprecated-config` and `update-bundled` | **Release-phase-specific** (enabled post-branching by release manager) |
